newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht dips in line with regionals, politics.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht dips in line with regionals, politics.

text.p: The Thai baht fell below the key 32 baht/dollar resistance on late Monday in the domestic market on worries about squabbling within the ruling coalition government and volatility of regional currencies, dealers said.
The baht was quoted in a bid/offer range of 32.05/32.15 to the dollar late on onshore compared with 31.90/32.00 in the morning.

Dealers said tight liquidity aggravated the baht's weakness, making it easier to move the currency through small dollar transactions. "The market is very quiet. Politics and jitters in regional currencies was the main factor today," said a dealer.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 14-15 percent late from 13-14 earlier.
